nodes.Name: ChaCha8
nodes.DocComment:
A ChaCha8 is a ChaCha8-based cryptographically strong
random number generator.

nodes.Name: NewChaCha8
nodes.DocComment: NewChaCha8 returns a new ChaCha8 seeded with the given seed.

nodes.Name: Seed
nodes.DocComment: Seed resets the ChaCha8 to behave the same way as NewChaCha8(seed).

nodes.Name: Uint64
nodes.DocComment: Uint64 returns a uniformly distributed random uint64 value.

nodes.Name: Read
nodes.DocComment:
Read reads exactly len(p) bytes into p.
It always returns len(p) and a nil error.

If calls to Read and Uint64 are interleaved, the order in which bits are
returned by the two is undefined, and Read may return bits generated before
the last call to Uint64.
